task.description: REWORK, iteration 1. TEST-DESIGNER (step-06) found a real BLOCKER-class defect that slipped through step-03/04/05: Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot is wired bare-module into lib/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure.ex's children list (line ~191), but the module never implements child_spec/1 (it deliberately is not a GenServer/Supervisor/Task -- see its own moduledoc for why: start_link/1 must run synchronously/blocking and always return :ignore, never {:error, _}). A bare module in a Supervisor children list without child_spec/1 crashes Letflow.Application.start/2 on EVERY boot -- reproduced directly by TEST-DESIGNER via `mix test` raising 'does not implement child_spec/1' before a single test runs. This is strictly worse than ISS-0771's original bug (total immediate outage on every boot, vs. a silent gap). Fix: add an explicit child_spec/1 function to Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot returning a map-form child spec, e.g. %{id: __MODULE__, start: {__MODULE__, :start_link, [init_arg]}, restart: :temporary} -- restart: :temporary because this is a one-shot boot step that must never be restarted by the supervisor (matching its 'runs once then :ignore' semantics; a :temporary child is never restarted regardless of exit reason, which is correct here since :ignore means 'do not track this child as running' in the first place). Do NOT change start_link/1's synchronous/:ignore behavior, the try/rescue, the logging, or infrastructure.ex's children-list ordering -- this is a narrow, additive fix only. After the fix, actually boot the application for real (not just mix compile) to prove the fix -- e.g. `mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs` (TEST-DESIGNER's step-06 tests are already committed at 1e2d9006 and require no changes) plus a full `mix test` run to prove the whole suite can now boot and run, not just these two files.
acceptance_criteria: child_spec/1 added to Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot, restart: :temporary, no other behavior change
the application boots successfully (mix test running past its boot phase is sufficient real-world proof -- quote the actual pass count, do not just say 'it compiled')

TEST-DESIGNER's already-committed step-06 tests (test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs new describe block, test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs) pass with ZERO test-code changes -- if you find yourself editing test files to make them pass, stop and flag it, that means the fix diverged from what TEST-DESIGNER verified via the throwaway-worktree shim
full mix test run quoted for real, not speculated
